bio.text: S. Elizabeth "Tizzy" Lockman has represented Delaware Senate District 3 since 2018 and has been Senate Majority Whip since 2020.

According to her official page, Lockman was raised in Wilmington, graduated from Alexis I. duPont High School, and holds a bachelor's degree from New York University and a master's degree in urban affairs and public policy from the University of Delaware.
The page says she was Parent Teacher Association president at her daughter's elementary school from 2010 to 2013 and is an adjunct professor at the University of Delaware.
